cases.name: Service metadata
cases.notes: Layer-scoped route. Responses are cached with the ImageServerMetadata output-cache policy.

cases.name: Colormap
cases.notes: Renderer-driven. Honua rasters are continuous with no intrinsic source colormap, so this read-only resource reflects the active renderer: a renderingRule whose Colormap function resolves a colormap (explicit stops, named ColorrampName, or an inline algorithmic/multipart Colorramp) returns the Esri { "colormap": [[value, r, g, b], ...] } document, consistent with what exportImage/legend render. Any other request returns the not-available response.

cases.name: Histograms
cases.notes: Returns per-band raster histogram documents when available.

cases.name: Export Tiles job child resources
cases.endpoint: GET /rest/services/{id}/ImageServer/jobs/{jobId}; GET /rest/services/{id}/ImageServer/jobs/{jobId}/results/out_service_url; GET /rest/services/{serviceId}/ImageServer/jobs/{jobId}; GET /rest/services/{serviceId}/ImageServer/jobs/{jobId}/results/out_service_url; POST /rest/services/{id}/ImageServer/jobs/{jobId}/cancel; POST /rest/services/{serviceId}/ImageServer/jobs/{jobId}/cancel
cases.notes: Durable asynchronous exportTiles job lifecycle (#2688): status, cancel, and the out_service_url result resource, on both the numeric-layer and service-name routes.

cases.name: Key Properties
cases.notes: Returns the Esri key-properties document for the primary raster, including BandProperties and cell-size metadata, from the shared raster store; non-applicable cases return spec-shaped empty documents.

cases.name: KML
cases.notes: Returns an OGC KML 2.2 KMZ (doc.kml) carrying a single GroundOverlay whose Icon href references the service exportImage operation over the WGS84 service extent and whose LatLonBox is that extent, mirroring the ArcGIS ImageServer KML resource. The resource reads only the aggregate catalog extent (reprojected to WGS84 via the shared transform service when the native SR is not geographic) and renders no pixels itself; the overlay image is produced on demand by the shared export pipeline when a KML client resolves the icon href. The self-referential exportImage href preserves whichever service addressing form (numeric-layer id or service name) the request used.

cases.name: Multidimensional Info and Slices
cases.endpoint: GET /rest/services/{id}/ImageServer/multidimensionalInfo; GET /rest/services/{id}/ImageServer/slices; GET /rest/services/{serviceId}/ImageServer/multidimensionalInfo; GET /rest/services/{serviceId}/ImageServer/slices; POST /rest/services/{id}/ImageServer/multidimensionalInfo; POST /rest/services/{id}/ImageServer/slices; POST /rest/services/{serviceId}/ImageServer/multidimensionalInfo; POST /rest/services/{serviceId}/ImageServer/slices
cases.notes: Returns spec-shaped multidimensional metadata and slices; non-multidimensional layers return {"variables": []} and an empty slice set, populated variables/slices when multidimensional coverage metadata is available.

cases.name: Raster Attribute Table
cases.notes: Returns a spec-shaped raster attribute table document; continuous and non-applicable rasters return an empty feature set with the field schema.

cases.name: Raster Function Infos
cases.notes: Returns the raster function info document for the resolved layer, advertising the functions accepted by renderingRule planning.

cases.name: Statistics
cases.notes: Returns per-band raster statistics documents when available.

cases.name: Tile
cases.notes: Supports png, jpeg, and tiff tile output. When multiple rasters overlap the requested tile, Honua renders a mosaic using the resolved merge strategy. Tile GETs use configured cloud file storage (local, S3, Azure Blob) as a deterministic loose-object read-through/write-through cache.

cases.name: Raster Catalog Item
cases.notes: Returns one raster catalog item as an Esri feature with catalog attributes and footprint geometry. Uses the shared catalog reader and applies the same access policy and field masking as ImageServer query.

cases.name: Raster Catalog Item Image and Info
cases.endpoint: GET /rest/services/{id}/ImageServer/{rasterId}/image; GET /rest/services/{id}/ImageServer/{rasterId}/info; GET /rest/services/{id}/ImageServer/{rasterId}/info/histograms; GET /rest/services/{id}/ImageServer/{rasterId}/info/keyProperties; GET /rest/services/{serviceId}/ImageServer/{rasterId}/image; GET /rest/services/{serviceId}/ImageServer/{rasterId}/info; GET /rest/services/{serviceId}/ImageServer/{rasterId}/info/histograms; GET /rest/services/{serviceId}/ImageServer/{rasterId}/info/keyProperties
cases.notes: Renders the selected raster through the canonical export pipeline and returns its storage info, key properties, and histograms from the canonical raster store. Both route families apply the ImageServer access policy; unknown raster IDs return an Esri 404 error document.

cases.name: Raster item thumbnail
cases.notes: Renders a small thumbnail of the raster item through the shared export pipeline; honours f=json for an href envelope. Note the served path is {rasterId}/thumbnail, not {rasterId}/info/thumbnail.

cases.name: WCS
cases.notes: WCS 2.0.1 KVP adapter for WCS-enabled raster layers. Supports GetCapabilities, DescribeCoverage, and GetCoverage over the primary raster with image/tiff, image/png, image/jpeg, SUBSET/BBOX spatial trim, SUBSETTINGCRS/BBOXCRS, optional OUTPUTCRS, RANGESUBSET band selection (band1..bandN, comma list and band1:bandN intervals), the full Scaling extension (SCALESIZE explicit per-axis sizing x(w),y(h); SCALEFACTOR uniform factor; SCALEAXES per-axis factors x(f),y(f); SCALEEXTENT per-axis grid intervals x(low,high),y(low,high) - at most one scaling operator per request, resolved against the subset-trimmed base grid), and phenomenonTime temporal subsetting (SUBSET=phenomenonTime("instant") or ("start","end"); the request must intersect the coverage acquisition time, else InvalidSubsetting). Capabilities advertise native CRSs for visible coverages; one-axis SUBSET is native-CRS only. The range-subsetting and scaling extension conformance classes are not advertised pending CITE validation. Multidimensional slicing beyond phenomenonTime, NetCDF, XML POST, and WCS-specific mosaic selection are deferred.

cases.name: WMTS
cases.notes: OGC WMTS 1.0 GetCapabilities/GetTile facade over the ImageServer tile/cloud-cache pipeline. Supports KVP and RESTful resources, WebMercatorQuad matrices, STYLE=default, image/png + image/jpeg + image/tiff tiles, GetFeatureInfo (application/json/text/xml) returning the pixel band values at the requested tile pixel, and a TIME dimension for temporal layers (GetTile/GetFeatureInfo honour a TIME parameter). Non-WebMercator tile matrix sets are deferred.

cases.name: Calculate Volume
cases.notes: Computes cut/fill volumes and 2D surface area per area-of-interest polygon against the layer associated DEM (raster_sensor_metadata.dem_source), integrating (elevation - basePlane) * pixelArea over DEM pixels in the AOI through the shared clip primitive. Partial: only a constant base plane is supported, the AOI is bounded by a per-operation pixel budget (over-budget returns 400), and a raster with no modeled DEM returns 501 rather than a fabricated value (ADR-0065).

cases.name: Compute Cache Info
cases.notes: Dynamic ImageServer layers return a spec-shaped cacheInfo object with the service extent and intentionally omit tileInfo/cacheType until a formal Esri-style raster tile cache is configured. The loose-object tile GET cache is operational storage, not advertised cache metadata.

cases.name: Compute Class Statistics
cases.notes: Computes per-class signatures over the classDescriptions training AOIs: pixel count, per-band mean vector, per-band min/max/stddev, and the band-by-band sample covariance matrix (n-1), over a single raster or a layer mosaic (rasterIds + mosaicRule) with an optional bandIds subset. Partial: bounded by a configurable per-class pixel budget (GeoServices:ImageServer:ClassStatistics:MaxPixelsPerClass) and renderingRule/multidimensionalDefinition are rejected with 501 because signatures are computed on source pixels.

cases.name: Compute Histograms
cases.notes: Returns per-band histograms without the parallel statistics array. Supports the same rasterIds, bandIds, mosaicRule, time, and histogramParameters.size selection path as computeStatisticsHistograms; An AOI geometry clips the analysis to that area (envelope-scoped); renderingRule execution remains deferred.

cases.name: Compute Pixel Location
cases.notes: Converts point geometries to raster pixel column/row coordinates using the raster geotransform, falling back to the raster extent when no affine transform is present. Supports rasterId and input spatial references when the shared CRS transform service is available.

cases.name: Compute Statistics and Histograms
cases.notes: Returns per-band statistics ({min,max,mean,standardDeviation,count}) and per-band histograms ({size,min,max,counts[]}). Supports rasterIds (CSV/JSON array of catalog object IDs; defaults to the selected layer mosaic), the Honua-extension bandIds selector (1-based), mosaicRule, single-instant time filtering to the newest layer-wide effective acquisition batch, and histogramParameters.size (default 256, capped at 1024). The parallel statistics[] and histograms[] arrays are aligned positionally: index i on both sides describes the same band. Multiple rasterIds are appended in request order. A band is only dropped from both arrays when neither the statistics nor the histograms result contained an entry for it; when a band is present on only one side, the missing side is zero-filled (an all-zero BandStatistic, or a BandHistogram with empty counts[]) so the parallel arrays stay index-aligned. An AOI geometry/geometryType clips the analysis to that area (envelope-scoped) for both single rasters and mosaics; without a geometry the full selected raster or mosaic is analysed. Stretch, Colormap, and Clip renderingRule chains are applied; ExtractBand, BandArithmetic, and pixelSize remain deferred.

cases.name: Compute Tie Points
cases.notes: Returns the raster pre-registered control points / GCPs from its sensor metadata, passed through verbatim and bounded to 10000 points per response. Partial by design: automatic feature detection / descriptor matching (how ArcGIS derives tie points) needs a computer-vision dependency this repository bars, so a raster with no modeled control points returns 501 rather than a fabricated result (ADR-0065).

cases.name: conf.json (tile-cache configuration)
cases.notes: Interop route, not Esri's tile-cache configuration document: it returns the ImageServer service descriptor. Honua's ImageServer is dynamic, so no fused cache is advertised by default (singleFusedMapCache/tileInfo are emitted only when the opt-in ImageServerTileMetadataOptions flag is set). It exists because the ArcGIS Maps SDK for .NET native runtime probes conf.json while loading an ImageServiceRaster and treats a 404 as fatal (#1456, #1648).

cases.name: Estimate Export Tiles Size
cases.notes: Estimates bounded WebMercatorQuad tile archive size; reports tilePackage/storageFormat for both ZIP and Esri exploded-cache TPK (storageFormat=tpk).

cases.name: Export Image
cases.notes: Default response is a JSON envelope with a temporary href; f=image streams the rendered bytes inline with the format-specific media type.

cases.name: Export Tiles
cases.notes: Exports bounded WebMercatorQuad image tiles to configured cloud file storage (local, S3, Azure Blob). storageFormat=zip (default) writes a flat {z}/{x}/{y}.ext ZIP and storageFormat=tpk (or tilePackage=true) writes an Esri exploded-cache TPK (v101/<cache>/_alllayers + conf.xml/conf.cdi); both are synchronous. Compact Cache V2 / TPKX (storageFormatType=esriMapCacheStorageModeCompactV2, or storageFormat=tpkx/compact/compactv2) submits a durable asynchronous job and returns the ArcGIS { jobId, jobStatus } envelope; the package is a real Esri TPKX 1.0 archive of Compact Cache V2 .bundle files. It requires the durable tile-export job runtime (an execution job store); when that is unavailable the request is rejected rather than silently downgraded.

cases.name: Find
cases.notes: Finds raster catalog images whose footprints contain toGeometry. Supports objectIds, where, inSR, fromGeometry validation, and maxCount. Results return catalog id/name, acquisition date, center, pixel size, rows, and cols; Esri camera/orientation-ranked image selection is deferred until sensor metadata is modeled.

cases.name: Get Samples
cases.notes: Samples pixel values at point, multipoint, polyline/polygon vertex, or envelope-center locations using the shared raster identify pipeline. sampleCount is capped at 1000.

cases.name: Identify
cases.notes: Point/envelope/polygon identify with JSON responses. A renderingRule renders the sampled pixel (post clip/stretch/colormap); raw source values are returned otherwise.

cases.name: Legend
cases.notes: Returns Esri-shaped layers[].legend[] swatches as base64 PNGs (image/png). Renders a 5-class equal-interval ramp keyed off the resolved layer mosaic's band-1 statistics by default; a renderingRule with an explicit Colormap is honoured (one swatch per colour stop). Per-layer renderer persistence and non-colormap renderer overrides are not yet honoured. Only f=json/f=pjson is accepted.

cases.name: Measure
cases.notes: Implements Basic map-space point, distance/azimuth, area/perimeter, and centroid mensuration over point, envelope, and polygon Esri JSON. Sensor/DEM-backed height and 3D operations return 501 until sensor/orientation metadata is modeled.

cases.name: Project
cases.notes: Reprojects Esri JSON geometry arrays between supported spatial references via the shared CRS projection pipeline and returns the Image Service geometries[] response shape. Envelope geometries remain envelope-shaped. datumTransformation is honored: a client-supplied geotransformation WKID (or composite geoTransforms) is resolved through the shared Esri WKID -> PROJ pipeline catalog and applied via 3-argument ST_Transform, matching the Geometry Service; an unknown/inapplicable WKID returns 400. The image-coordinate-system transformation parameter is still rejected with 400 until neutral support is added.

cases.name: Query
cases.notes: Returns Esri-compatible raster catalog features (OBJECTID, footprint polygon, MinPS/MaxPS/LowPS/HighPS/CenterX/CenterY/ZOrder/Shape_Length/Shape_Area/BandCount/PixelType/AcquisitionDate/CreatedAt). Supports where (parsed via the GeoServices SQL filter parser, applied in-memory; max 2000 chars), objectIds, outFields projection, orderByFields, an envelope-intersects spatial filter, outSR (footprint rings and the aggregate extent are reprojected when a transform is available), single-instant time filtering to the newest layer-wide effective acquisition batch, resultOffset, resultRecordCount (default 100, capped at 1000), and the returnGeometry/returnIdsOnly/returnCountOnly/returnExtentOnly shaping flags. Spatial WHERE pushdown to the database, pixelSize, and non-envelope geometry/spatialRel predicates are not yet honoured.

cases.name: Query Boundary
cases.notes: Returns the aggregate raster footprint boundary as Esri shape plus approximate area. The boundary is extent/footprint based; NoData-trimmed single-raster boundaries are deferred.

cases.name: Raster item image support data
cases.notes: Returns the Esri-shaped imageSupportData (sensor name, camera model, and interior/exterior/RPC orientation presence flags plus DEM source) projected from the raster sensor-metadata companion. Partial: only rasters with a modeled sensor-metadata row carry support data; a plain COG reports not-available rather than a fabricated empty support-data document.

cases.name: Raster item source file
cases.notes: Route exists and resolves the raster item, then returns a precise capability-honest not-available response: Honua stores raster pixels in the provider (PostGIS raster / analytic stores) rather than referencing a downloadable source file, so there is no file to stream. Never a fabricated payload.

cases.name: bbox, imageSR, bboxSR, interpolation, compressionQuality
cases.notes: CRS inputs for imageSR and bboxSR accept numeric WKID, EPSG:####, OGC CRS URI/URN, bracket-safe forms ([EPSG:####]), and CRS84 aliases. compressionQuality is validated to 0-100 and maps to JPEG QUALITY or TIFF JPEG_QUALITY when applicable.

cases.name: format
cases.notes: Supports png, jpg, jpeg, tif, and tiff.

cases.name: f
cases.notes: Supports json, pjson, and image. f=image returns rendered bytes inline with the format-specific media type; html is not supported.

cases.name: size
cases.notes: Accepts Esri-style width,height dimensions from 1,1 through 4096,4096; omitted values default to 400,400.

cases.name: pixelType
cases.notes: Validated but not applied.

cases.name: compression
cases.notes: Applied to TIFF output only. Supports None, JPEG, and LZ77; LZ77 maps to GDAL DEFLATE. Ignored for non-TIFF outputs.

cases.name: renderingRule
cases.notes: Executes a Stretch (MinMax/StandardDeviation/PercentClip, optional per-band Statistics), a Colormap (explicit [value,r,g,b] stops or a named ColorrampName), and a Clip (envelope/polygon, including ClippingType=1 keep-outside). Identity / StretchType=0 are no-ops. Unrecognized stretch/colorramp variants and inline Colorramp objects return 501; unknown functions return 400. Chain planning/validation is internal (there is no computeClass route): the planner walks Identity / Stretch / Colormap / Clip / ExtractBand nodes (max chain depth 8) and rejects unknown functions with a 400 naming the offending node. Output pixel type defaults to U8 when the chain includes Stretch and F32 otherwise, unless the document overrides outputPixelType.

cases.name: mosaicRule, time
cases.notes: mosaicRule accepts merge-strategy tokens or an Esri-style JSON object and is applied when multiple rasters intersect the request. time accepts a single ISO 8601 instant with the active raster.temporal-mosaic entitlement; Honua selects the newest layer-wide effective acquisition batch (AcquisitionDate, falling back to CreatedAt) at or before the timestamp, then applies the export bbox/window.

cases.name: multidimensionalDefinition
cases.notes: Registered Zarr coverages support a bounded native-CRS grayscale PNG slice for GET/POST numeric and service-name routes. Requires one coordinate per selected dimension, format=png, and RSP_NearestNeighbor; JPEG/TIFF, reprojection, advanced interpolation, renderingRule, bandIds, noData, time, and mosaicRule combinations are rejected explicitly and tracked by #2717.

cases.name: geometry, sr, returnCatalogItems
cases.notes: sr accepts numeric WKID, EPSG:####, OGC CRS URI/URN, bracket-safe forms ([EPSG:####]), and CRS84 aliases.

cases.name: geometryType
cases.notes: Only esriGeometryPoint is supported.

cases.name: f
cases.notes: Only json and pjson are supported.

cases.name: mosaicRule, time
cases.notes: mosaicRule is applied when the identify point intersects multiple rasters. time accepts a single ISO 8601 instant with the active raster.temporal-mosaic entitlement; Honua selects the newest layer-wide effective acquisition batch (AcquisitionDate, falling back to CreatedAt) at or before the timestamp, then applies the identify point.

cases.name: renderingRule
cases.notes: When supplied, identify returns the rendered pixel value (post clip/stretch/colormap, matching exportImage) instead of the raw source value; omitting it preserves the raw-value contract. Executes the same Stretch (MinMax/StandardDeviation/PercentClip), Colormap (explicit stops or named ColorrampName), and Clip (envelope/polygon, including ClippingType=1 keep-outside) support as exportImage; unsupported chains return 400/501.

cases.name: mosaicRule, time
cases.notes: mosaicRule is applied when multiple rasters overlap the requested tile. time accepts a single ISO 8601 instant with the active raster.temporal-mosaic entitlement; Honua selects the newest layer-wide effective acquisition batch (AcquisitionDate, falling back to CreatedAt) at or before the timestamp, then applies the tile envelope.

cases.name: where
cases.notes: Parsed via the shared GeoServices SQL filter parser and applied in-memory against catalog metadata fields (OBJECTID, Name, MinPS, MaxPS, LowPS, HighPS, CenterX, CenterY, ZOrder, Shape_Length, Shape_Area, BandCount, PixelType, AcquisitionDate, CreatedAt). Limited to 2000 characters; spatial WHERE pushdown is not yet supported.

cases.name: objectIds
cases.notes: Accepts CSV (1,3,5) or JSON array ([1,3,5]) form.

cases.name: outSR
cases.notes: Stamped onto the response spatialReference. Footprint geometry is NOT reprojected â€” clients must inspect each feature's geometry-level spatialReference to detect that the rings remain in the raster's native SRID.

cases.name: resultOffset, resultRecordCount
cases.notes: resultOffset defaults to 0; resultRecordCount defaults to 100 and is capped at 1000. Sets exceededTransferLimit when the page is truncated.

cases.name: returnGeometry, returnIdsOnly, returnCountOnly, returnExtentOnly
cases.notes: returnExtentOnly emits the aggregate extent computed after where/objectIds filtering and before pagination.

cases.name: f
cases.notes: Only json and pjson are supported.

cases.name: geometry, geometryType, inSR, spatialRel, outFields, orderByFields, pixelSize
cases.notes: Spatial filtering against arbitrary client geometries, per-field projection, ordering, and pixel-size hints are not yet honoured.

cases.name: time
cases.notes: Accepts a single ISO 8601 instant and filters the catalog to rasters in the newest layer-wide effective acquisition batch (AcquisitionDate, falling back to CreatedAt) at or before the timestamp with the active raster.temporal-mosaic entitlement.

cases.name: rasterIds
cases.notes: Accepts CSV (1,3) or JSON array ([1,3]) of catalog object IDs. When omitted, defaults to the selected layer mosaic rather than a single primary raster. Unknown IDs return 400 Bad Request.

cases.name: bandIds
cases.notes: Accepts CSV or JSON array of 1-based band indices. Forwarded to the raster store as the band selector. The caller-supplied order is preserved when aligning the parallel statistics[]/histograms[] arrays.

cases.name: histogramParameters.size
cases.notes: Bin count, capped at 1024. Default is 256 when omitted.

cases.name: f
cases.notes: Only json and pjson are supported.

cases.name: mosaicRule, time
cases.notes: mosaicRule is applied when rasterIds is omitted and multiple rasters participate in the selected mosaic. time accepts a single ISO 8601 instant with the active raster.temporal-mosaic entitlement; Honua selects the newest layer-wide effective acquisition batch (AcquisitionDate, falling back to CreatedAt) at or before the timestamp before computing statistics/histograms.

cases.name: geometry, geometryType, renderingRule
cases.notes: AOI geometry clips analysis to its envelope. Stretch, Colormap, and Clip renderingRule chains are applied; ExtractBand and BandArithmetic return an explicit not-implemented response.

cases.name: pixelSize
cases.notes: Pixel-size analysis hints are not yet honoured.

cases.name: f
cases.notes: Only json and pjson are supported. Other formats return 400 Bad Request.

cases.name: renderingRule
cases.notes: An explicit Colormap renderingRule produces one legend swatch per colour stop. Other renderer overrides remain deferred; without a Colormap the response uses a 5-class equal-interval ramp keyed off the resolved layer mosaic's band-1 statistics.

cases.name: GetCapabilities
cases.notes: Returns WCS 2.0.1 XML with OWS service metadata, operations metadata, WCS service metadata, Contents coverage summaries, and ServiceMetadata crs:crsSupported advertisement values (in the xs:any Extension slot) covering each visible coverage's native CRS plus the default WGS84/WebMercator identifiers the CRS registry can resolve. The advertisement is additive: no CRS-extension conformance class is declared, so the document stays valid for the WCS core ETS. ACCEPTVERSIONS, ACCEPTFORMATS, and SECTIONS are validated.

cases.name: DescribeCoverage
cases.notes: Accepts repeated or comma-separated bare integer COVERAGEID values and returns GML 3.2 bounds/grid metadata plus gmlcov rangeType band metadata.

cases.name: GetCoverage
cases.notes: Accepts exactly one bare integer COVERAGEID. Supports image/tiff, image/png, image/jpeg, SUBSET/BBOX spatial trim, SUBSETTINGCRS/BBOXCRS, and OUTPUTCRS over the primary raster (each client-supplied CRS is validated against the coverage's advertised transformable set; a parseable but non-transformable value returns 400 OutputCrs-NotSupported or SubsettingCrs-NotSupported per OGC 11-053r1 rather than a downstream error), plus RANGESUBSET band selection, the Scaling extension (SCALESIZE, SCALEFACTOR, SCALEAXES, SCALEEXTENT - at most one operator per request, applied to the subset-trimmed base grid), and phenomenonTime temporal subsetting (slice or trim against the coverage acquisition time; non-intersecting windows return InvalidSubsetting). Single-axis SUBSET fills the omitted axis from the stored raster extent only when the subsetting CRS is native; non-native SUBSETTINGCRS/BBOXCRS callers must supply both axes or use BBOX. Known unsupported WCS extensions return 501 OWS ExceptionReport XML; unknown GetCoverage parameters return 400.
